svg.title: ESP-Drone Android app — Tune screen
svg.desc: The PID tuning screen: live angle and controller charts at 20 Hz with roll/pitch statistics, the three gain values with tap-to-edit, and the auto-tune block with the hold-to-start button.
svg.text: Landscape only · minSdk 21 · WiFi, Bluetooth Classic SPP and BLE GATT · se.bitcraze.crazyfliecontrol2
Phone tilt is inert until you switch it on.
pair first · WiFi off in this mode
two taps within 3 s cuts motors
always on the stick — never tilt
tap a value to edit the parameter
auto-tune — one axis at a time
Load / Save Mission Planner .waypoints files · long-press adds a waypoint · tap sets a go-to target
tap to edit · handles · body drag
Shapes snap to 5° and whole metres on release.
The plan is shared with the Mission screen (NavStore),
so the zones edited here are the zones the runner flies.
tap = add waypoint · keep-out zones refuse the tap
write the plan to the drone
Home → flight origin: the app sends it before
Upload / Start — the drone has no GPS.
